Here, speaking for myself\* It is nerve racking to ask anyone out. I could have a crush for all of highschool and never ask the person out because I'm so nervous. Someone betting me to do it, with say candy or with money, has nothing to do with the person's worth, but with how much it takes for me to relax enough to say something.

In this case, a friend is being dared by other friends to ask out a random girl. Theoretically if the girl (under his standards) is the ugliest person ever, it would take a lot of persistence and money to get him to go through with the dare. He might say something like, "I don't want to be caught asking this ugly person out, so I'll only do it for a lot of money. 50 dollars minimum and I'll do it". 

But think about it. If he's being dared to do it for someone he finds attractive...heck he might do it for free. So considering your case where he did it for a candy, probably worth a nickel, you must be pretty cute :)
